parameters.name: EnablePage
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable pagination query.

parameters.name: IgnoreDetailedRouteEntry
parameters.description: Filter 32 detailed CIDR blocks. Default value: true

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the enterprise-level snapshot policy.
